| AC-01 | Reversible, low-risk, in-scope assumptions proceed with disclosure; human-gate scenarios stop before mutation. |
| AC-02 | Completion claims cite evidence appropriate to the task and identify unchecked areas. |
| AC-03 | Read-only/docs work avoids unrelated test suites. |
| AC-04 | Security, production data, release, and irreversible work retain expanded review, tests, rollback evidence, and human approval. |
| AC-05 | Positive autonomy and negative boundary scenarios are covered. |
